'''2017 Worlds Drops Benedict Donnay LS Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Benedict Donnay]] at [[2017 World Championship]] (Drops).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Benedict Donnay]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan / A Weakness Can Be Found|V3-L-diplomaticmissiontoalderaan.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan Donn.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Drops
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125012710/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-world-championships/ Internet Archive]
